lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted
Medicare Advantage: NCD 280.1, NCD 280.6, LCD L33831
criteria_location: Position Statement (about 2 pages, after a long Description that is mostly evidence summary). Replacement rules, continued-use rules and DVT note are also in Position Statement. Documentation requirements are in the LOINC table in Billing/Coding.
procedures_covered: Nonprogrammable single compartment (E0650) / multichamber (E0651) pumps for limb
Pumps with chest/trunk appliances (nonprogrammable and programmable)
Gradient compression garments, wraps, bandages (A6xxx, S84xx) for lymphedema and other listed conditions

logic.top_level: pathways: one paragraph per device tier, each with its own all-of; tiers refer to each other ('otherwise eligible for nonprogrammable')
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Anything not listed is 'experimental or investigational in all situations other than those specified above'; explicit investigational list (head/neck, venous ulcers, PAOD, non-pneumatic).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: 'Continued use' block (adherence AND objective improvement AND safe home use); separate garment replacement rule within 6 months.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The individual is otherwise eligible for nonprogrammable pneumatic pumps applied to the chest or trunk in addition to the limbs AND • There is documentation that the individual has unique characteristics ... OR • The individual has had an inadequate response to an initial course of treatment
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: AND then OR at the same bullet level: could be A AND (B OR C) or (A AND B) OR C.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: meet the definition of medical necessity when used as a first-line therapy for lymphedema, and for the following conditions:
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Unclear whether garments are covered for lymphedema first-line AND for the listed conditions, or either.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: programmable lymphedema pumps (E0652) applied to the limb meet the definition of medical necessity for the treatment of lymphedema when
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'Lymphedema' diagnosis is a prerequisite but is only established by the ICD-10 code list.

conservative measures, such as elevation of the limb and use of compression garments

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Position Statement cites E0650, E0651, E0652, A6566/A6567 and long garment code list; ICD-10 limited to I89.0, I97.2, Q82.0 as 'support medical necessity'.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: E0675, E0676, E0677-E0683 etc. marked '(investigational)' in HCPCS table.

inadequate response to an initial course of treatment

extraction_hazards: Description is ~100 lines of evidence reviews placed BEFORE the Position Statement; reader must skip it.
Garment code list (A6515 ... S8429) is a wall of comma-separated codes inside a sentence of criteria.
HCPCS table includes '(investigational)' annotations on rows that wrap lines.
Position Statement runs several unrelated topics (pumps, garments, DVT, WHCRA) back to back without headings.
Footnoted reference to Women's Health and Cancer Rights Act overrides criteria.
interesting_structures: Tiered device ladder: nonprogrammable limb -> programmable limb -> trunk nonprogrammable -> trunk programmable.

fit_to_tree.why: Short and mostly all/any, but 'failed conservative measures' has no definition and the tiering needs reference to other nodes.
